about_the_game:
Deck of Stabs is a cutesy roguelike deckbuilder where every single card is a weapon. No shields, no spells—just pure stab energy. Build a deck of nothing but brutal, beautiful, pixel-art weaponry and unleash it on everything that stands in your way.

Choose from five unique stab-happy heroes:

  • Steelhand – A battle-hardened warrior who crushes enemies with swipes and stuns.

  • Bladedancer – A flurry of fast, cheap attacks with razor-sharp precision.

  • Hexrazor – A twisted sorcerer who curses foes and stabs corpses to fuel unholy power.

  • Runecutter – A barrage of ancient shards that unleash explosive magical power.

  • Zerker – A bloodthirsty little rage-a-holic who gets stronger with every kill.

As you play, you’ll build a personalized deck of weapon cards, creating powerful combos that evolve with each run. Level up to gain unique passive skills and character perks. Find items and treasures that grant special buffs, unlock synergies, and stack into devastating chains of attacks.

With its charming pixel art, fast-paced combat, and pure-stab mechanics, Deck of Stabs offers a fresh twist on the roguelike deckbuilder genre. Every run is a new opportunity to sharpen your deck, stab smarter, and maybe—just maybe—become the ultimate stabber.

short_description: Every card is a weapon. Every decision matters. Battle through strange worlds and dangerous dungeons. Discover exotic weapons, powerful gear, and deadly skills. Burn, curse, explode, and smash your way to victory. Every run is different—just bring your best blades.
